description.narrative:
BEGE-projektet omfattar 14 provinser i Afghanistan. Programmet fokuserar på följande: i) distrbitution av läromedel ii) driva byskolor iii) tillhandahålla utbildningsmöjligheter för tonåringar iv) utveckling av en skolmodell som inkorporerar frågor om barns skydd och förändrad pedagogik v) alfabetiseringsinsatser för kvinnor 15-45 år.
Stödet är ett projektstöd och utgör fortsättning på tidigare BEGE-stöd.

The BEGE-project to be supported by Sweden is focusing on 14 provinces in Afghanistan. The project is focusing on the following: i) distribution of teaching and learning materials ii) community based education iii) accelerated learning centers for youth iv) child friendly schooling v) literacy for women 15-45 years old.
The support is a project support and it's a continuation of a previous support to BEGE in Afghanistan.

Sida did not conduct a conclusion of performance during the second year of the intervention, it was therefore decided to do a more in depth concluding assessment. Unfortunately, it was not possible to extract relevant examples and evidence based results from the reporting from UNICEF.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
